dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Well, looks like I found another job... That's good...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler! Thanks for introducing me to this job.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: As we agreed, the future maintenance of this shrine will become my responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: As for my payment... ah, the provisional head priestess says that she'll think of something. I just need to take care of the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Hmm. Maybe I should try making a few wood carvings in my free time later.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: See you! You work hard too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know how to carve wood as well?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Why, of course! I'll have you know that I'm a dab hand at a few different crafts.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: These wooden carvings here were all made by me using Lady Neko in various poses as a reference.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: These carvings are very small, and can be held and played with in your hand, or displayed in your home as ornaments.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I've been thinking to get someone to help me bring a batch of these — once I'm done making them, of course — to Narukami Island to see if anyone's willing to buy them.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: If we find willing customers, this might become a decent business venture.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: And if I earn some money, I can spruce this shrine up even further!

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I imagine that the provisional head priestess would be most pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: As for the whole payment, uh... I guess I'll just wait for that "Hibiki" person to come back and give it all to me at once, eh?
